    Preprojective components and directedness #

    A preprojective component contains the summands of minimal right almost split maps into its members and has left almost split families inside it, so with a global bound it is a closed class (PreprojComp.closedClass). Hence a connected algebra of bounded representation length with a preprojective component is representation-directed (directing_of_preproj).
